title: brief.md is the card, the brief as written, a blank line and the fleet JITSO rules with the budget sentence
source: intended: docs/decisions.md, the v0.1.0 cut, rows 1 and 2: the launch appends JITSO's rules text to the end of brief.md
intent: A fleet launch of a build with a budget appends the fleet text: it never asks a human and reports to the session that launched it. The end of the file is pinned by an anchored regex and the card and the brief by contains. The no-budget fleet text is covered by the unit tests of internal/card only.

regex:
## JITSO rules
Start other agent sessions only with the card's `launch:` line\. The card's budget is your ceiling: near it, stop and report\.
Load the card's skills before any other work\. Never ask a human: send your questions and your final report \(a count of done, failed, open\) to the session that launched you\.
Leave `jitso/`, `\.jitso/` and `~/\.jitso/` alone except your own draft in `\.jitso/drafts/`, and never run `jitso build save`\.
$
